name_de: Cube Reaction Hybrid SLX 800 artline Easy Entry
name_en: Cube Reaction Hybrid SLX 800 artline Easy Entry
description_de: Das Cube Reaction Hybrid SLX 800 artline Easy Entry ist ein E-Hardtail-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist, bedient wird er über Bosch Kiox 500. Federung: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Schaltung: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Reaction Hybrid SLX 800 artline Easy Entry is an electric hardtail mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery, controlled via Bosch Kiox 500. Suspension: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Drivetrain: Shimano XT Di2 RD-M8260-SGS, 12-Speed, Electronic Shifting System. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
motorDetails: Bosch Drive Unit Performance Line CX max. 120Nm (BDU38)
